body: variants.WithDensities(base, factors...) declares one ordinary variant per factor named DensityName(base,k) (avatar-2x, avatar-1_5x; '-' and '_' because the name pattern has no '@' or '.'), so generation, keys, Prune, eager, quota and the handler need nothing new. Never upscale: at generation the source header is probed (Processor.Probe) and a version is made at min(factor, largest factor the source fills), never below 1x (ModeFill limited by the smaller source/box ratio, ModeFit and ModePad by the larger). The capped version still exists so an app requesting avatar-3x by name never gets 404; the row digest stays the declared transform's (as with focal points). DensitySrcSet advertises each version's REAL density (width over 1x width, 2 decimals) and drops versions adding no pixels, so a capped 3x says 2.5x and is displayed at the right CSS size. Handler dpr selection is opt-in (HandlerOptions.Density): ?dpr, then Sec-CH-DPR, then DPR, rounded up to the next declared factor, Vary: Sec-CH-DPR, DPR. Density versions inherit the base's WithHeaders unless given their own (resolved after all options so order does not matter); WithEager must come after WithDensities (fails loudly at New otherwise).
title: Density variants (IM-27) are ordinary declared variants, capped at the source's pixels
